surrealdb_authority_v02_205.supersedes: Any PostgreSQL, Postgres, PgPool, sqlx-postgres, SQL-DDL, JSONB, RLS, LISTEN-NOTIFY, pgvector, DATABASE_URL, PostgreSQL test-container, or PostgreSQL proof instruction elsewhere in this pre-pivot contract.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.implementation_rule: When this MT reads or writes durable product state it MUST use the typed SurrealDB boundary created by MT-331..MT-334 and the authenticated record-user plus ResourceBroker privacy contract from MT-333. It MUST NOT add a PostgreSQL fallback, parallel authority, direct pool escape, or runtime dependency.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.proof_rule: PostgreSQL-era fixtures and historical receipts do not prove this MT. Fresh real-SurrealDB proof is required for every storage-affected acceptance criterion; administrative SurrealDB credentials cannot prove privacy.

title: SC-MT001-SessionModelTypes

scope.summary:
GOAL: Create the transport-agnostic typed session model for long-lived steerable agent-CLI sessions: a new module src/backend/handshake_core/src/agent_sessions/ with the Thread/Turn/Item shape (Codex app-server shape, also mappable onto Claude stream-json and ACP), serde round-trip guarantees, a typed turn state machine, and SurrealDB persistence rows following the existing ModelLaneStore patterns. Today every agent-CLI run is one-shot (prompt as argv, stdin NULL — see official_cli_bridge.rs AttachedStdioContract::null_stdin_piped_output() call at src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/cloud/official_cli_bridge.rs line 2303 inside spawn_attached_child, used by LiveCliSpawner::spawn at line 2425). This MT defines the durable model those sessions will populate; the Claude/Codex/ACP adapter families (MT-021+/MT-041+/MT-061+) and the transport/runtime MTs (MT-002..MT-010) all build on these types, so the seams must be crisp and additive-only.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: (a) new directory src/backend/handshake_core/src/agent_sessions/ with mod.rs, types.rs, store.rs; (b) one-line module registration `pub mod agent_sessions;` in src/backend/handshake_core/src/lib.rs (alphabetical position near `pub mod ace;`); (c) new integration test file src/backend/handshake_core/tests/agent_sessions_model_tests.rs. No changes to swarm_orchestration, model_runtime, sandbox, or process_ledger in this MT.

TYPE CATALOG (types.rs — all types serde Serialize+Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq; enums serde rename_all snake_case; TurnItem externally tagged with tag="kind"):

- pub struct SessionId(uuid::Uuid) — newtype, harness-pinned: the HARNESS mints the UUID and later pins it onto the transport (e.g. `claude --session-id <uuid>`), so provide BOTH `SessionId::new_v7()` (Uuid::now_v7 per HBR-INT-008) and `SessionId::from_uuid(Uuid)`. impl Display (plain hyphenated uuid), FromStr with typed parse error. Never accept transport-minted ids as primary identity.
- pub struct TurnId(uuid::Uuid) — same newtype discipline, new_v7().
- pub struct SteerMessageId(uuid::Uuid) — minted here (used by MT-002/MT-008), new_v7().
- pub enum AgentAdapterKind { ClaudeCode, CodexAppServer, AcpBridge, FakeEcho } — FakeEcho is the test-only counterparty kind used by MT-010; label() -> &'static str ("claude_code", "codex_app_server", "acp_bridge", "fake_echo") mirroring CliKind::label at official_cli_bridge.rs line 70.
- pub enum ThreadState { Idle, TurnActive, Closed, Failed } with is_terminal().
- pub enum TurnState { Queued, Generating, AwaitingApproval, Steered, Interrupted, Completed, Failed, Cancelled } with fn is_terminal(self) -> bool (Completed|Failed|Cancelled|Interrupted are terminal; Interrupted is terminal for the TURN, the THREAD stays resumable) and fn can_transition_to(self, next: TurnState) -> bool encoding the legal machine: Queued->Generating|Cancelled; Generating->AwaitingApproval|Steered|Interrupted|Completed|Failed|Cancelled; AwaitingApproval->Generating|Interrupted|Cancelled|Failed; Steered->Generating (steer applied, generation continues); every terminal state -> nothing.
- pub struct AgentThread { pub session_id: SessionId, pub adapter_kind: AgentAdapterKind, pub state: ThreadState, pub cwd: Option<String>, pub worktree_id: Option<String>, pub swarm_id: Option<String>, pub parent_session_id: Option<String>, pub created_at_utc: chrono::DateTime<Utc>, pub updated_at_utc: chrono::DateTime<Utc> } — cwd/worktree_id/swarm_id mirror the attribution fields already carried by CliInvocationContext (official_cli_bridge.rs lines 161-189: session_id, parent_session_id, swarm_id, worktree_id, working_dir) so ledger rows and threads join naturally.
- pub struct AgentTurn { pub turn_id: TurnId, pub session_id: SessionId, pub seq: u32, pub state: TurnState, pub items: Vec<TurnItem>, pub started_at_utc: DateTime<Utc>, pub ended_at_utc: Option<DateTime<Utc>>, pub exit: Option<StructuredTurnExit> }.
- pub enum TurnItem { AssistantText { text: String }, Reasoning { text: String }, ToolCall { name: String, input: serde_json::Value, call_id: Option<String> }, ToolResult { call_id: Option<String>, body: String }, SteerMessage { message_id: SteerMessageId, text: String, queued_at_utc: DateTime<Utc> }, InterruptRequest { message_id: SteerMessageId, requested_at_utc: DateTime<Utc> }, StructuredExit { exit_code: Option<i32>, reason: String } } — the first four variants deliberately mirror the already-shipped AgentActivity parser variants (src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/cloud/agent_activity.rs enum AgentActivity at line 68: ToolCall/Thinking/Text/Other; parse_line at line 125). Provide pub fn turn_item_from_activity(a: &AgentActivity) -> TurnItem mapping Text->AssistantText, Thinking->Reasoning, ToolCall->ToolCall, Other->AssistantText with a raw passthrough marker in text — lossless, never dropped, matching agent_activity.rs's defensive contract.
- pub struct StructuredTurnExit { pub exit_code: Option<i32>, pub reason: String, pub mapped_state: TurnState }.
- pub enum AgentSessionError (thiserror): InvalidTransition { session_id: SessionId, turn_id: TurnId, from: String, to: String }, ThreadNotFound(SessionId), TurnNotFound(TurnId), IdParse(String), Store(#[from] SurrealStoreError), Serde(#[from] serde_json::Error), CapabilityMissing { session_id: SessionId, capability: String, adapter_kind: String } (variant reserved here so MT-003 extends without a breaking enum change).

PERSISTENCE (store.rs — follow ModelLaneStore at src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/model_lane.rs lines 60-118 exactly: SurrealDbClient field, official SDK query with conditional revision-checked SurrealDB upsert, record_json typed SurrealDB object column stamped with a schema_id, updated_at_unix_ms):
- pub struct AgentSessionStore { pool: official SurrealDB Rust SDK::SurrealDbClient } with pub fn new(pool: SurrealDbClient) -> Self.
- SCHEMAFULL record types defined by the MT-332 SurrealKit rollout and verified by store startup: agent_session_thread uses a typed record id, required revision/state/adapter_kind/record object/updated datetime fields plus optional worktree and swarm fields; agent_session_turn uses a typed record id, required session record link, sequence/state/record object/updated datetime fields, and a unique compound index over session and sequence. Both apply authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS.
- record_json stamps: {"schema_id":"hsk.agent_thread_record@1", ...} and {"schema_id":"hsk.agent_turn_record@1", ...} following the model_lane.rs record_session_cleanup_receipt schema_id pattern (line 82: "hsk.swarm_session_cleanup_receipt@1").
- API: pub async fn upsert_thread(&self, thread: &AgentThread) -> Result<(), AgentSessionError> (conditional SurrealDB UPSERT transaction that advances revision only when the stored revision matches); pub async fn load_thread(&self, id: &SessionId) -> Result<Option<AgentThread>, AgentSessionError>; pub async fn upsert_turn(&self, turn: &AgentTurn) -> Result<(), AgentSessionError> — upsert_turn MUST enforce the state machine: read current persisted state, reject illegal transition with AgentSessionError::InvalidTransition (fail closed, never silently overwrite); pub async fn list_turns(&self, id: &SessionId) -> Result<Vec<AgentTurn>, AgentSessionError> ordered by seq; pub async fn list_threads_for_worktree(&self, worktree_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<AgentThread>, AgentSessionError>.

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Read the grounding files first: official_cli_bridge.rs lines 60-320 (CliKind, CliInvocationContext, CliInvocationReceipt), agent_activity.rs lines 58-135 (AgentActivity, parse_line), model_lane.rs lines 17-130 (ModelLaneStore + upsert pattern), process_ledger/mod.rs lines 62-114 (ProcessOwnershipRecordId new_v7, SpawnMeta session fields).
2. Create src/backend/handshake_core/src/agent_sessions/mod.rs with module docs stating the transport-agnostic contract (this module NEVER imports claude/codex/acp-specific code; adapters translate INTO these types) and pub use re-exports of every public type above.
3. Implement types.rs. All UUID mint sites use Uuid::now_v7() (HBR-INT-008); derive Serialize/Deserialize with explicit serde attrs; write the TurnState transition table as a match, not a HashSet, so the compiler forces exhaustiveness.
4. Implement turn_item_from_activity with the lossless mapping described above; unit tests in types.rs cover every AgentActivity variant.
5. Implement store.rs per the catalog; every write path is SurrealDB-only (no sqlite — no_sqlite tripwire applies to authority writes).
6. Author tests/agent_sessions_model_tests.rs: (a) serde round-trip for AgentThread/AgentTurn/every TurnItem variant (serialize -> deserialize -> assert_eq); (b) TurnItem JSON tag stability test pinning the exact wire strings ("assistant_text", "reasoning", "tool_call", "tool_result", "steer_message", "interrupt_request", "structured_exit"); (c) full transition-matrix test: for all 8x8 (from,to) pairs assert can_transition_to matches the documented machine; (d) illegal-transition persistence test and SurrealDB round-trip tests gated on a managed-SurrealDB env (HANDSHAKE_TEST_SURREALDB_ENDPOINT or the packet's managed-SurrealDB harness); absence of the real SurrealDB endpoint is a typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF blocker and cannot satisfy this MT.
7. Register `pub mod agent_sessions;` in lib.rs. cargo build -p handshake_core green; clippy clean on the new module.
forbidden_paths: src/frontend/** (native UI arrives in the GUI family, not this MT)
acceptance_criteria: src/backend/handshake_core/src/agent_sessions/{mod.rs,types.rs,store.rs} exist and `pub mod agent_sessions;` is registered in lib.rs; cargo build -p handshake_core is green.
SessionId/TurnId/SteerMessageId are Uuid newtypes with new_v7() (Uuid::now_v7, HBR-INT-008) and SessionId additionally has from_uuid for harness pinning; Display/FromStr round-trip.

TurnState has exactly the 8 states Queued/Generating/AwaitingApproval/Steered/Interrupted/Completed/Failed/Cancelled and can_transition_to matches the documented machine (proven by the exhaustive 8x8 matrix test).

TurnItem has exactly the 7 variants AssistantText/Reasoning/ToolCall/ToolResult/SteerMessage/InterruptRequest/StructuredExit with pinned snake_case wire tags; serde round-trip passes for every variant.
turn_item_from_activity maps all 4 AgentActivity variants losslessly (agent_activity.rs enum at line 68); no variant is dropped.

AgentSessionStore::upsert_turn rejects an illegal persisted state transition with AgentSessionError::InvalidTransition (fail closed); legal transitions bump revision through a conditional SurrealDB transaction following the typed-store pattern.

SurrealDB tests run green against a managed SurrealDB when HANDSHAKE_TEST_SURREALDB_ENDPOINT (or packet managed-SurrealDB harness) is present; absent -> typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF skip, never fabricated PASS.
record_json rows carry schema_id hsk.agent_thread_record@1 / hsk.agent_turn_record@1.
No sqlite on any agent_sessions write path; no claude/codex/acp-specific import inside agent_sessions/.
proof_targets: cargo test -p handshake_core agent_sessions_model --nocapture 2>&1 | tee /tmp/mt001_run.txt && grep -E 'test result: ok' /tmp/mt001_run.txt
expected_tests: serde round-trip per TurnItem variant + wire-tag pin test
turn_item_from_activity lossless mapping test (all AgentActivity variants)
AgentSessionStore real-SurrealDB conditional upsert/load/list plus illegal-transition fail-closed test
implementation_notes: Transport shape provenance: Codex app-server exposes Thread/Turn/Item with turn/steer + turn/interrupt; Claude stream-json exposes system/init + assistant/user message envelopes (agent_activity.rs module docs lines 33-56 record both dialects as researched 2026-05-31); ACP session/prompt is sequential-turn only. The model must express all three, which is why SteerMessage/InterruptRequest are TURN ITEMS (history is append-only, transport-agnostic) rather than transport frames.

Interrupted is turn-terminal but NOT thread-terminal: Claude SIGTERM aborts the turn and exits 143 while the session remains resumable via --resume from the same cwd; the ThreadState stays Idle-resumable. MT-005 encodes the exit-code mapping; MT-006 encodes the cwd-scoped resume rule.

Do NOT add capability flags, steer-queue logic, stdio plumbing, or HTTP surfaces here — those are MT-003, MT-002, MT-004, MT-007 respectively. This MT is types + persistence only, so downstream MTs never rebase on churned types.

AwaitingApproval exists because both Claude (permission prompts in non-bypass modes) and Codex app-server (approval requests) can park a turn on operator consent; the consent decision itself flows through the existing ConsentGate (model_runtime/cloud/consent_gate.rs) wired in MT-007.

seq on AgentTurn is the per-session monotonic turn ordinal; UNIQUE (session_id, seq) makes concurrent double-append a typed conflict instead of silent reorder (HBR-SWARM-001 groundwork for MT-010's race proofs).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless backend type-model + persistence MT; no operator-visible surface changes. HBR-VIS-004 satisfied by durable rows (agent_session_threads/turns) reconstructable as a TraceProjection.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Internal type/persistence scaffold with no operator-usable command yet; the UserManual entry lands with MT-007 (session API surface) which exposes the first operator-callable behavior.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: internal_diagnostics (may be typed DEFERRED if the internal-diagnostics tier is not yet shipped for agent_sessions)
palmistry (may be typed DEFERRED if palmistry wiring is not yet shipped for agent_sessions)
risk_if_missed: No shared session model: every adapter family invents its own thread/turn shape, steering and resume become transport-coupled, and the WP-017 session runtime cannot be built without rework across MT-002..MT-010 and MT-021+/041+/061+.

risks: RISK-1: Transport bleed — Claude/Codex-specific fields or imports leak into the core types, silently coupling the transport-agnostic seam and forcing adapter families to fork the model.

RISK-2: State-machine drift — can_transition_to and the store's persisted-transition guard disagree (or the guard is skipped on upsert), letting an illegal Generating->Queued style regression be silently persisted.
RISK-3: Wire-tag churn — serde tags change later and previously persisted record_json rows stop deserializing, corrupting session history.
RISK-4: UUID v4 creep — a convenience Uuid::new_v4() mint site violates HBR-INT-008 and breaks time-ordered id joins with ProcessOwnershipLedger rows.
RISK-5: SurrealDB tests silently skipped forever — the managed-SurrealDB gate hides the persistence proof and the store ships unproven.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): grep proof target asserts zero claude/codex/acp tokens in types.rs; adapters translate INTO the model, module docs state the rule.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): single source of truth — the store guard calls the same can_transition_to; the 8x8 exhaustive matrix test plus an illegal-persist test pin both sides.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): wire-tag pin test asserts the exact serde tag strings; changing a tag fails the build and forces a schema_id bump (hsk.agent_turn_record@2) instead of silent drift.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): grep proof target for Uuid::now_v7 in types.rs; code review rejects new_v4 outside test fixtures.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): the real-SurrealDB suite is mandatory completion proof; a missing endpoint emits a typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF blocker and cannot be counted as a pass.

surrealdb_translation_v02_205.schema_rule: Any embedded PostgreSQL DDL/SQL snippet is a semantic field/index/invariant inventory only. Implement it as SCHEMAFULL SurrealQL through SurrealKit; do not execute or mechanically transliterate the snippet.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.concurrency_rule: Translate advisory locks, SKIP LOCKED and row locks into SurrealDB transactions, durable lease/fencing records and conditional updates with equivalent tests.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.notification_rule: Translate LISTEN/NOTIFY into scoped SurrealDB live queries plus bounded resynchronization.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.privacy_rule: Translate RLS into authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker; administrative credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.proof_rule: All named storage proofs run against real SurrealDB. No PostgreSQL process, driver, connection, fixture, environment variable or fallback is permitted.
